notes: The lyrics are timed from the song itself now. Words with no timed file used to go to a model that spread them evenly over the duration - a split by line count, so a short intro and a repeated chorus pushed the later lines aside.
The audio decides instead: the lines are laid out by how much singing each one holds, then every start is snapped onto the nearest rise in the track, so a line lights when something actually begins.
It needs no key and no network, and answers the same way every time. A stored timing whose gaps are all the same size is re-measured, so songs already carrying the old flat guess are fixed too.

The Sync button is still there and still uses a model, but it is no longer told to split evenly - it is asked to space the lines by how long each is sung and to leave a real gap where the song has a break.
The word-by-word and letter-by-letter highlight are untouched, and still pace each word by the syllables it really holds.
The three link tools are named for the format each one makes first, and the other choices are spelled out underneath instead of filling the title.
